purpose: Test channel complementarity by question capability, not manufacture a monotonic ordering
old_v1_to_v5: historical evidence and development only; unchanged

taxonomy.name: 多条件交集与适用范围

initial_targets.final_sample_size: Determine before test freeze using dev discordance and source ICC sensitivity;240 is not a power guarantee; if larger size unaffordable reduce claim, not filter failures

primary_hypothesis: Three-route source-grounded path retrieval improves complete necessary evidence on independently verified S4/S5 versus dual retrieval under matched source-candidate/context budgets
secondary_hypotheses: Dual improves over the stronger single retriever selected on dev, on the fixed answerable capability mixture
Graph path constraints reduce invalid direction, source/model mismatch and certainty inflation
Predicted-intent routing preserves simple-query quality and avoids graph cost
global_ordering_rule: Only claim triple>dual>single if both paired contrasts pass on the SAME predeclared population and fixed weighting; different type subsets cannot establish a global order

methods.router: question-only, trained/fixed on dev, never gold task type

common_controls.generator_and_prompt: same across arms in later paid answer stage
common_controls.reranker: same identity in primary retrieval comparison

secondary: valid directed/qualified explanation chain rate (requires adjudicated generated chain)
answer factual support and citation correctness (separate generation stage)
abstention and certainty preservation on S6
Minimum original-chunk support size / shortcut audit; a quality metric, not a retrieval success score

inference.unit: source-event bundle / connected source family; not individual question
inference.multiple_confirmatory_comparisons: If a global ordered claim is preregistered, control its paired contrast family with Holm; keep per-type intervals descriptive unless separately powered

graph_pipeline_gate: Source-only extraction and provenance validated before authoring test questions
Mention-to-canonical-entity links require same source scope and explicit coreference/role evidence; equal names are insufficient
Keep engine/component roles, negation, uncertainty and revision boundaries
At least genuine two/three-hop chains exist and every edge has source evidence
Freeze graph and source representations before test authoring; do not insert gold paths into the normal graph index
benchmark_integrity: Question rewriting and source-verified annotation correction permitted with version history
No question deletion/reweighting based on method wins or losses
Do not split naturally self-contained passages merely to force graph dependence
Accept all verified alternative sufficient evidence sets
Every claimed hop must pass single-unit/bridge necessity review
Source-only manually curated graph is a disclosed upper-bound diagnostic, separate from automatic-graph main result
Semantic hop count and minimum required original retrieval-chunk count are separate labels
S4 requires at least2, S5 at least3 necessary original stable chunks; three annotated sentences within one chunk do not satisfy S5
If any verified alternative sufficient set collapses the retrieval task, relabel complexity before rankings; do not discard based on method performance
